package.name: forklift_autonomy
package.description: Mission manager for the forklift: Manual / Auto mode, a state machine for approach, pick (F3) and later transit and drop, motion primitives and a bay-axis servo. It drives through /cmd_vel/auto (twist_mux priority 50 behind teleop) and /fork/cmd_height, and uses only perception messages, wheel odometry, TF, the fork joint and operator commands (docs/PLAN_CV_AUTONOMY.md, R1/R9).
